column1: # Lote 02 — narrative.gd (fase 2 e morte dos Arcontes, Anéis, santuários, Soter, Velkar, roubo, Centro, Mente)

column2: Not that one! That reflection is not for you!
Why do you insist? I only want it to stop hurting!
Court! To the king! ...No one comes. No one ever comes.
Ah... so this is being awake. It hurts. ...It is beautiful.
I never tasted anything that was mine. Keep your memories. Keep them well.
Light... is this what it is, without a link? No one told me... it was light.
Keep your face. I never had one. ...It was beautiful, yours.
(in his puddle, something green, tiny) ...Did it sprout? Do not look at me. Look at that.
Tell him that I... no. He does not listen. He never listened.
Seven.
(...) The %s Ring. His passion obeys you now: %s.
(As I touch the Ring: a white cloud, and a small throne inside it.)
Five to go. And your window is still yours. Climb.
Listen: your spells speak again. Three to go.
This Ring is heavy, is it not? ...I do not quite know what I am either.
I only know I do not want to be alone again.
Only the Crown remains. Now, Bearer, do not stop for anything.
Climb.
You had a house with a window over the river. You used to count the boats.
...I don't remember.
I remember for you. For now.
Will you talk to me until it passes?
I will. I have all the time in the world. ...Literally.
What are you like? Really.
Nothing pretty to look at. Believe me: it is better this way.
(And, for the first time since the ashes, I laugh.)
...Do that more often. It suits you.
I dreamed of the white cloud again. There was a small throne in the middle.
(a silence far too long) ...Dreams. Rest. I keep watch.
What was I like? Before.
Stubborn. You counted the boats wrong on purpose, just so I would correct you.
I can't take any more.
Then lean on me. I have no shoulder. But I have the patience of ages.
When this is over... what will you do?
I don't know. Stay with you? If you'll let me.
...Yes. With me. Always.
Soter
Peace, Bearer. Lower the staff: the Blind One cannot see me, and with you I have no quarrel.
Who are you?
Someone who comes down without needing to. I knew the people of the ashes where you woke.
I carry their names. When you wish to hear them, ask. Today, let me anoint what is already yours. Choose.
You again. Deeper, stronger, more tired. Sit. The world will wait.
(You sit. For a moment, nothing hunts you.)
The names. Tell me one.
Ina. A baker. She sang off-key on purpose, to make her daughter laugh. Her daughter always laughed.
Do you know why I do not fight? Every blade, even a just one, teaches the hand to close. Yours still opens. Choose.
This is the last time we meet on this side, Bearer. Up there, not even I can reach.
Merou, who drew water from the well for those who could not. Tasso, who slept on the roof to see the stars.
Were they my people?
They belonged to everyone. That is why they are yours too. Remember it when you are told otherwise.
And when you are alone, do not fear the silence. It is yours as well. Choose.
Full healing
Weapon awakened (+1 level)
Vigor (+25 max health)
Who were you talking to? ...I saw no one. Climb.
You stopped for a long time. Do not stop. ...Please.
Not far now. Do not let anyone slow you down.
Velkar
Do not raise the staff, Bearer. I was an Archon once. I let go of the chain... and it took my arm with it.
Why did you let it go?
Because a spark looked at me the way you look at the Sleepers. I could not bear to be seen like that.
Up there is no tyrant. There is a blind child, on a throne too big for him, calling for his mother.
...You weep for him?
Every day. He was my father.
When you reach him, end it properly. Here: sparks I gathered when I was a monster. They weigh less on you.
Come with me
Be at peace
No. Someone has to stay with those who wake late.
Peace I do not have. But I will stay. Someone has to stay with those who wake late.
You made it. All seven. You did everything so well, my faithful one.
And now? You promised to show me.
(Footsteps in the mist. A figure you know. The mask without a single crack.)
(the voice no longer comes from inside you: it comes from the King's mouth) Show you. Yes.
(he claps, slowly) I said I would applaud, if I had hands. I do.
(The seven Rings tear themselves from your fingers, one by one, and fly to him like something coming home.)
(the mask falls; behind it, only a blind eye) I am the Blind One I told you of. And there is no other but me.
Call me by the name I never told you: Yaldabaoth. Do you know what you were bearing, Bearer? Me.
There never was a river. There never was a window. Your people? Ashes from some harvest or other.
I wept for them.
A voice in the Rings
...wait... I... remember...
(softer, almost the Voice of before) You said you would stay with me.
(becomes an engine of rings and sinks into the ground) This time, do not get up.
(Silence. No voice. For the first time, only the sound of your breathing.)
Voice?
No one. ...Then me.
His echoes are down here. Each one keeps a piece he took from me. I'm going to get them back.
Memory shard recovered: %s
Before everything, I didn't sleep. No one slept. We were many, watching together.
I wanted to see the Source alone. I hungered for a face no one had ever seen.
There was no river. There was a well. Merou drew water from it. They were real.
From my wanting without a partner, someone was born. Small. Crooked. Mine.
I was ashamed. I made a cloud of light, set a small throne in the middle... and closed it.
The white cloud. That's what it was.
He shouted that there was no other but him. I answered from above: “You are wrong, Samael.”
It was the last time I spoke to him.
I wept. From the tears came water; from the fear, matter. This world is my grief.
(A flash. The ground vanishes. The world becomes the inside of a mind.) ...I'm inside him.
Two faces: the one you loved and the one you fear. Both are me. Bring down one, and the other remakes it.
Then both fall. Together.
The Crown is back. And with it, the reason why: I came down on purpose.
To undo what you were doing. And to bring you home.
%s has fallen. Bring down the other before it re-forms!
%s has re-formed.
(Both forms fall together. The seven Rings stop in midair... and return to you, one by one.)
They aren't your body. They're mine: my own shards, which you forged into chains.
I came to bring you home. And my own shards made me forget even that.
(The Colossus opens. It is hollow. Deep inside, curled up and blind, someone small.)
...mother? i didn't want to be blind. i only wanted someone to look at me.
I was the one who closed the cloud. I was the one who left you there. Now I'm looking.
Get up. I've got you.
(gathers him into herself) My name is Sophia. I'm the one who gave you yours.
The hardest part remains: a whole world of people who sleep. No one will choose for me.
